title: Corridor Reproducibility Register review packet
description: One packet per case study. All evidence quotes must be copied verbatim from the mirrored primary document.

case_id.description: Archive stamp of the case study exactly as printed in the source document.

title.description: Exact title printed in the case study.

doi.description: DOI exactly as printed in the case study.

evidence_path.description: Path of the mirrored primary document inside this registry, e.g. candidates/<slug>/README.md.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim sentence copied from that document which justifies the verdict (at least 20 characters).

reported_mae.description: MAE reported by the candidate's own document, or null when none is reported.

selected_submission.description: Slug of the compliant submission closest to the reference MAE, or null if there is none.

corridor_id.description: Corridor identifier printed in the case study.

origin_cn.description: Origin station name in Chinese as printed.

origin_en.description: English station name as used in international timetable listings, e.g. 'Jinan West', 'Dezhou East'.

destination_cn.description: Destination station name in Chinese as printed.

destination_en.description: English station name as used in international timetable listings, e.g. 'Jinan West', 'Dezhou East'.

direct_high_speed_service.description: True when a direct G-series high-speed service connects the two stations on the service date printed in the case study.
